verdict.rationale: Publishing robots.txt is a fair question for any public web service, so the axis applies. The only robots.txt probe, on the employer transactional host secure.esd.wa.gov, returned the SecureAccess Washington login shell instead of a robots policy. No evidence shows a real robots.txt on esd.wa.gov.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
